text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Sunday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Israeli army officer killed in Hizbollah mortar attack in Lebanon.
- Two U.N. soldiers shot dead in Syria.
- Egyptian envoy Osama al-Baza here with summit proposal.
- German musician signs hotel tab: "Adolf Hitler".
- Palestinian who sold a house to an association of settlers is murdered by gunshots near Ramallah.
- Tension among Ehud Barak's people in Labour party for fear they'll find themselves outside the leadership team.
- Assessment is the Palestinian secret security service liquidated the land dealer.
- Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's bureau chief Moshe Leon says many requests from abroad have been received to invest in Israel and the economy is getting out of its slowdown.
- Fury in Israel over killing of third land dealer.
- In message brought by the Russian ambassador to Israel, Syria says: Golan withdrawal not a condition for negotiations.
